sprint.name: Foundation & Core Pipeline
sprint.goal: Establish affiliate feed ingestion, AI caption generation, and multi-platform social posting with monitoring.

user_stories.title: Affiliate Network Integration — SOVRN
user_stories.description: As a pipeline operator, I want to pull product feeds from SOVRN so that I have a primary source of affiliate products.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/feeds/sovrn returns at least 5 products when credentials are valid
Circuit breaker trips after 3 consecutive 5xx errors
AuthError is raised (not RuntimeError) on 403 responses

user_stories.title: Affiliate Network Integration — TakeAds
user_stories.description: As a pipeline operator, I want to pull CPC products from TakeAds so that I have a secondary affiliate source.
acceptance_criteria: TakeAds API key is read from environment
Top 5 products by commission are returned
Fallback to next network when TakeAds fails

user_stories.title: Affiliate Network Integration — Admitad
user_stories.description: As a pipeline operator, I want to parse Admitad XML feeds so that I can access a wide product catalogue.
acceptance_criteria: XML YML catalogue parsed correctly
rzekl.com wrapper and aff_short_key preserved in all links
Top 5 products by commissionRate selected

user_stories.title: Affiliate Network Integration — Travelpayouts
user_stories.description: As a pipeline operator, I want travel affiliate products from Travelpayouts as a fourth fallback source.
acceptance_criteria: Travel products fetched and normalised to standard product schema
Used only when higher-priority networks fail

user_stories.title: Bluesky Social Posting
user_stories.description: As a marketer, I want affiliate posts published to Bluesky so that I reach the decentralised social audience.
acceptance_criteria: Post includes image blob upload via AT Protocol
Affiliate URL embedded as card link
AuthError raised on 403 — circuit breaker NOT tripped
Caption under 300 chars

user_stories.title: Mastodon Social Posting
user_stories.description: As a marketer, I want affiliate posts published to Mastodon so that I reach the Fediverse audience.
acceptance_criteria: Media uploaded then attached to status
AuthError on 401/403
Instance URL configurable via settings

user_stories.title: Meta Platforms Posting (Instagram / Facebook / Threads)
user_stories.description: As a marketer, I want posts on Instagram, Facebook, and Threads so that I reach the Meta ecosystem.
acceptance_criteria: _find_image() returns (bytes, url) — Meta platforms use url path
Graph API container + publish pattern followed
AuthError on token expiry

user_stories.title: Dashboard — Real-Time Status
user_stories.description: As an operator, I want a single-page dashboard showing pipeline runs, platform status, and spend so I can monitor health at a glance.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard served at /
Shows last 10 run history entries
Platform status badges green/red per circuit breaker state
Daily spend vs cap displayed

user_stories.title: Prometheus / Grafana Monitoring
user_stories.description: As an SRE, I want Prometheus scraping /metrics and Grafana dashboards so that I can observe system health over time.
acceptance_criteria: GET /metrics returns valid Prometheus text exposition
docker-compose.monitoring.yml starts Prometheus + Grafana
Grafana reachable on port 3001
Prometheus scrape config points at app host:7860

definition_of_done: All DEFAULTS keys present in api/utils/settings.py
